title: Application Project Manager
description:
Working Title: Application Project Manager (22910-1)
Schedule: M-F, Day shift position with flexibility based on project needs
Location: 369 Oyster Point in South San Francisco, CA.(3 Days Onsite)
Duration: 6-12+ Months Contract

Mandatory areas – Cadence Analyst – 5-8 years of experience

Must Have skills:
- Project management
- Epic HIM
- Risk management
- Project planning

Must have Certifications – Epic Referral & Authorization certification required Epic MyChart certification required Epic Cadence certification preferred


UCSF is looking for someone that is in the Bay Area and able to be onsite as needed at the New Oyster Point Location.
Looking for Application PM's (not construction/relocation). Yes those departments are relocating but the PM will be leading the application build activities. This PM will be assigned to Lab and one for Pharmacy. The PM should have significant PM experience with EPIC Beaker and Willow build/implementation/optimization respectively. This project will focus on the centralization of both Lab operations to the Oyster Point location. The Technical Project Manager will lead the planning, coordination, and execution of the UCSF Health Central Laboratory relocation and activation project at the new Building located at 369 Oyster Point in South San Francisco. This highly visible, enterprise-wide initiative includes the consolidation of Laboratory Services into a centralized, state-of-the-art laboratory facility designed to enhance operational efficiency, scalability, automation, and service quality across the health system. The incumbent will manage complex cross-functional efforts involving laboratory operations, equipment and automation integration, IT infrastructure, Epic Beaker and laboratory systems implementation, workflow redesign, operational readiness, regulatory compliance, and organizational change management. Working closely with executive leadership, laboratory operations, clinical stakeholders, Health IT teams, and external vendors, the Project Manager will be responsible for governance, budget and schedule management, risk mitigation, stakeholder engagement, and transition planning to ensure a seamless relocation and successful activation of the centralized laboratory environment while supporting UCSF Health's long-term strategic goals for innovation, growth, and excellence in diagnostic services.

*Relocation of the actual Lab services….not new construction perse.

Required Qualifications
EPIC PM experience required 5 to 7 years of project management experience.
Minimum 2 years of healthcare industry experience.
Experience managing technology related initiatives.
Ability to anticipate obstacles and develop contingency plans.
Strong attention to detail and prioritization skills.
Experience selecting and implementing project management methodologies.
Strong leadership, negotiation, and problem solving skills.
Advanced organizational and project management capabilities.
Experience tracking project budgets, schedules, metrics, and resources.
Ability to communicate effectively with all levels of an organization.
Experience leading teams of technology professionals.
Ability to integrate information across disciplines and align projects with business strategy.
Bachelor's degree in a related field or equivalent combination of education and experience.

Preferred Qualifications
Advanced knowledge of computing and communications infrastructure, networking, software operations, and disaster recovery.
Experience working with Epic applications.
PMP Certification from PMI.
Epic Certification in one or more Clinical or Revenue Cycle applications.
